abrams.description: An M1A2 Abrams tank assigned to the 98th Cavalry Regiment,  fires a tank round at a target during a live fire qualifications at the Udairi Multi Purpose Range Complex, Kuwait, August, 2023.The M1A2 System Enhancement Package Version 2 (SEPv2) is an upgraded version of the M1 Abrams main battle tank.It features improved electronics, including updated command, control, and communication systems.(U.S. Army Photo by Sgt. Joaquin Vasquez-Duran).
